recipeSceneDescription.concentrate: Focus on your tasks with bright white light. With full brightness, these cool tones give you the light you need to get things done.
recipeSceneDescription.doze: End the day with low, warm light. It's the perfect shade and brightness for your bedroom, especially when you're trying to start snoozing.
recipeSceneDescription.energize: Get energised with cool, blue-toned light. This light recipe helps you add a little pep to your morning or an extra punch to your workout with 100 per cent brightness.
recipeSceneDescription.read: Get the right shade of bright, warm light to read in. Curl up with a good book in your reading nook and read in comfort.
recipeSceneDescription.relax: Unwind with dimmed, warm light. Turn your lights to these low, golden tones to help you ease your mind and body.
